notes: Moved the MusicVerse catalog to the shared Yellowdawg Supabase project as the authoritative remote data source.

Created a namespaced musicverse_* library with normalized artists, songs, albums, recordings, genres, personnel, instruments, playlists, saved items, listening events, references, and featured-album history.
Seeded the current catalog while preserving stable GitHub album and track IDs, Spotify identities, CoverVerse ordering, and SoundTrail ordering.
Added read-only Supabase views for Cover Albums, album details, Crazy Covers, and SoundTrail.
The browser now reads the catalog from Supabase first and exposes a visible bundled-catalog fallback if Supabase is unavailable.
Personal playlists, favorites, references, listening history, and feature history remain local until MusicVerse authentication is wired.
